# The Corsairs of Captain Flariel

*Page PDF 3*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

_When clouds cover the moon and the sea fog rolls in, the Dark Elves strike from their sleek vessels. Cloaked corsairs swing onto enemy ships or slink into remote coastal villages, the air ringing with cruel laughter heralding the sound of slaughter. They seek plunder or captives, bound for a life of misery in frozen Naggaroth._ 

The Corsairs of Captain Flariel are a ship-borne band of Dark Elves who harry the coasts of the Old World. Captain Flariel is a swashbuckling thrill-seeker, who lives for the excitement and unpredictability of adventure. The sorceress Rakaria seeks ancient Elven artefacts to improve her standing in the treacherous city of Ghrond. Below decks in the bowels of the _Raptor’s Talon_ , a band of wretched captives plot an uprising against the cruel overseer Corvian Sabeth… though without help, they are doomed. 

This supplement is one of a series detailing small bands of antagonists or dubious allies for your game. It provides information on Dark Elf corsairs and suggestions for how to use Flariel’s Reavers. It also includes a profile for a Dark Elf ravenship, compatible with the rules in **Sea of Claws** . 

When using Flariel’s Reavers, you should determine what the Characters know about the Druchii. You can assume Elf 

Characters know the history of the Sundering and the nature of the Dark Elves, while Old World Humans, Dwarfs, and Halflings are unlikely to know much, if anything. There may be exceptions, such as seafarers, scholars, veteran soldiers, or explorers who may have heard about, or even encountered, the Druchii. The _Olde Weirde_ section of this supplement illustrates a resourceful Human scholar’s understanding, although the learned gentleman of Altdorf is better informed than most. You can assume the average peasant or townsman struggles to differentiate between Elven cultures, if indeed they have ever encountered any of the species. 

This supplement also provides a profile for Dark Elves in **Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay** and a set of creature templates for ship-bound raiders — these combine with the Bestiary in the **WFRP Core Rulebook** to create NPC Norscan sailors, Bretonnian buccaneers, Goblin pirates, or other types of reavers who attack ships or come ashore to kill and plunder. 

Finally, there are profiles for Captain Flariel and three other important Characters from the _Raptor’s Talon_ . There are tensions between Flariel’s Reavers… underlying conflicts which could erupt into violence or rebellion, particularly if an inventive group of Characters tips the scales.
